papers.canonical_title: ManimCode: Learning Visual Self-Correction for Educational Animation
papers.abstract: ManimData preserves render-verified animation programs and trajectories of errors, visual critiques and revisions. ManimCode trains a single 4B model through role-conditioned supervision and revision reinforcement learning to write, review and revise educational animations.

source_records.evidence: Official metadata, canonical history and version-pinned full PDF.

papers.screening_reason: A trained multimodal controller emits executable Manim programs and rewrites them in response to rendered-frame critique, layout diagnostics and execution errors.
screening_evidence: Sections 3.2 and 4.2; Appendix A.3: complete program rewriting, best-candidate retention and shared inference loop settings.
papers.analysis_target: Task-time scene-level ManimCode render–review–revise controller using the SFT+RL 4B model. Data construction and RL rewards are described separately, not mixed with inference feedback or long-form planners.

workflow.reasoning: Single ordered refinement path; crash versus rendered feedback changes inputs rather than introducing a search graph.

update_strategy.reasoning: Full rewrite supports Regeneration; best-result retention supports Candidate Selection; explicit return to best revision base supports Rollback, rather than inferring a patch interface from small displayed diffs.

verifier.reasoning: Same backbone supplies Self critique; deterministic geometry diagnostics are Programmatic; renderer outcomes are Environment checks affecting repair.

feedback_assessment.reasoning: Scores are loop-internal Score, defect descriptions Diagnosis, executable versus failed render Binary. Final Gemini judge is not included.

memory_reach.reasoning: The central retained candidate state is shared across this single-backbone role system, supporting Global Memory rather than separate per-agent stores.

action_type.evidence: Writer and Reviser emit full Manim programs for execution.

graphics_software.evidence: Native ManimCE v0.19.1 Python programs and eight domain plugins.
graphics_software.reasoning: Direct native scripts, not a new agent-operation abstraction; general-purpose software despite harness validators.

tools.evidence: Renderer executes programs; layout checker flags outside-frame objects, overlap and tiny labels.
tools.reasoning: Execution/rendering is Execution Utilities; fixed layout checking Static Validator. Reviewer is already the controller, not a separately called perception tool.

resources.evidence: 2,219 API cards include documentation, best-practice rules and rendered example scenes; inference retrieves cards.
resources.reasoning: API/rules support Documentation & Rules; accessed example snippets support Examples & Trajectories, not the offline training corpus alone.

papers.limitations: Render success does not ensure educational correctness. Appendix C.5 shows oscillating overlap/clipping defects; best-candidate retention can preserve an imperfect output. Human evaluation uses one team annotator on 98 pairs and agreement is poor for small judge-score differences. RL mainly improves render success rather than quality.
taxonomy_delta: Single backbone with explicit reviewer role makes Self versus Critic a boundary; use Self here because the same model reviews its own outputs.
